name: Scholarship Scheme
benefits: Financial support up to Rs.10,000/year covering tuition fees, books, and exam fees.
eligibility: Students with family income below Rs.2.5 lakhs per year
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in or visit District Education Office

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefits: Direct income support of Rs.6,000/year in three installments of Rs.2,000 directly to bank account.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with landholding up to 2 hectares
how_to_apply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centre (CSC)

name: Farmer Support Scheme
benefits: Subsidized seeds, fertilizers, and crop insurance for registered farmers.
eligibility: All registered farmers with valid land records
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Agriculture Department office or apply at agri.gov.in

name: Women Welfare Scheme
benefits: Free skill training, health check-ups, and financial assistance for women entrepreneurs.
eligibility: Women above 18 years with family income below Rs.3 lakhs per year
how_to_apply: Apply at wcd.nic.in or visit Women and Child Development office
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development - wcd.nic.in

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
benefits: Maternity benefit of Rs.5,000 in three installments for first living child.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women aged 19 years and above for first living child
how_to_apply: Register at Anganwadi Centre or pmmvy-cas.nic.in
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development - pmmvy-cas.nic.in

name: Senior Citizen Pension Scheme
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs.200-Rs.500 per month for senior citizens below poverty line.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above from BPL households
how_to_apply: Apply through Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body office

name: Education Loan Scheme
benefits: Collateral-free education loans up to Rs.7.5 lakhs for higher studies in India and abroad.
eligibility: Students who secured admission in recognized institutions through merit-based selection
how_to_apply: Apply at any nationalized bank or through vidyalakshmi.co.in

name: PM Awas Yojana
benefits: Housing subsidy up to Rs.2.67 lakhs on home loans for EWS and LIG families.
eligibility: EWS/LIG/MIG families who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India
how_to_apply: Apply at pmaymis.gov.in or through registered bank or housing finance company

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefits: Health coverage of Rs.5 lakhs per family per year for hospitalization at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Families listed in SECC 2011 database; covers 10.74 crore vulnerable families
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or visit any empanelled hospital Ayushman Mitra

name: Skill India PMKVY
benefits: Free skill training with monetary reward of Rs.8,000 on completion and industry-recognized certification.
eligibility: Indian nationals aged 15-45 years who are school/college dropouts or unemployed
how_to_apply: Register at pmkvyofficial.org or visit a PMKVY training centre

name: Startup India Seed Fund
benefits: Financial assistance up to Rs.20 lakhs for proof-of-concept and Rs.50 lakhs for market entry.
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startups incorporated less than 2 years ago with innovative solution
how_to_apply: Apply at startupindia.gov.in through the Startup India hub portal
